name: Hammerhead Karoo Live Broadcast Bridge
description: Streams live Biketerra ride telemetry (GPS, speed, power, cadence, HR, gears) over UDP to a Hammerhead Karoo, where the companion app plays it back as mock GPS. Also pushes the ride route to your Hammerhead account as a native route.

settings.label: Karoo Wi-Fi IP Address
settings.description: The Wi-Fi IP shown on the Karoo (also displayed by the companion app). Must match for UDP delivery.

settings.label: UDP Port
settings.description: UDP port the companion app listens on.

settings.label: Elevation offset (m)
settings.description: Added to the game's elevation before sending to the Karoo. The Karoo's altitude display can sit above or below the game's (geoid / mean-sea-level correction). To make them match, enter (game − Karoo): e.g. game shows 20 m while the Karoo shows 25 m → enter -5.

settings.label: Hammerhead / SRAM Email (Auto-Login)
settings.description: Your Hammerhead login email. Used to automatically fetch & refresh your 1h dashboard JWT and user ID.

settings.label: Hammerhead / SRAM Password (Auto-Login)
settings.description: Your Hammerhead password for automatic token refresh.

settings.label: Hammerhead Refresh Token (Optional Fallback)
settings.description: Auto-populated on login, or paste your refresh_token from dashboard.hammerhead.io if using SRAM SSO.

settings.label: Hammerhead user ID (Auto-detected if blank)
settings.description: Auto-extracted from the JWT 'sub' claim when using auto-login, or enter manually.

settings.label: Hammerhead dashboard token (Optional Manual Override)
settings.description: Auto-refreshed when using email/password or refresh token.
